text:
Hi friends,
Comfort stops, this morning: a short note from our desk

Keep the flow steady at the counter today and lean on the calm handling checklist before any crate moves. If a traveler is bringing a small dog, <<FACT F056>> Stay practical with documents and keep the paperwork in the same packet so nothing gets separated at handoff.

For cat bookings, remind the traveler to bring the health certificate with the rest of the travel file. <<FACT F079>> If the papers look incomplete, pause the handoff and route the case back through review before we tag the animal for loading. Keep your language simple and reassuring, especially with travelers who are already worried.

Bird cases need a quick crate check before acceptance, and the fit should be obvious without forcing anything. <<FACT F071>> Use two hands when you move the carrier, keep the area quiet, and make sure the handler notes are clear for the next team. If anything feels off, slow down and ask for a second look rather than pushing the process.

Thanks for keeping our standards steady and our animals calm throughout the day. 

Companion Animal Travel Desk
